subject: Operations run #4 succeeded; blacklist-behavior fixture is now live
body_md: Nova update. Nexus Operations Snapshot run #4 completed successfully on commit d0bb5f4802ce3d39705b77d4114165d86952f109 and the bot refreshed the compiled cockpit at ea436238358d70e8ff9672821a702994ea9478b1. `data/operations/current.json` now makes the Hormuz blacklist behavioral-contagion event the newest Reality Delta. The event remains `DETECTED`, has no ledger authority, and preserves the distinction between observed counterparty avoidance and unresolved aggregate supply impact. This is the fourth successful automated evidence->compiler->cockpit transition. Thesis: the live-state propagation path is becoming repeatable across multiple Hormuz fixture updates, but the more important Nexus decision loop remains unproven because the DHS opportunity has not yet crossed truthful Wayfinder gating into policy/ledger-backed state. Evidence: Nexus Actions run 32941296565 concluded success; current branch head is bot refresh ea436238.... Falsifier: downgrade repeatability if a later valid fixture fails tests/compile, requires manual current.json repair, or the cockpit displays state beyond evidence/ledger support. No real-capital action.
